summary: Current unchanged 4c305 candidate: both model families and all five effort-menu positions were exercised through the shared adapter (10 combinations). Four real Native Tools routes (5.6 Sol/medium, 5.6 Pro/max, 6 Sol/medium, 6 Pro/max) completed native read, apply_patch and byte-for-byte command verification, with actual model/effort/permissions/workspace and accepted-send ledger checks. Initial newline mismatches were detected by commands and corrected by the models; original failures are retained. Standard/triple catalog budgets and unchanged effort groups/transport limits passed. Existing candidate DOM/history/text extraction regressions passed in full verify. The previously omitted isolated Electron viewport test is now explicitly enabled and passed 90 assertions at 100%/125% zoom, zero native size, tab completion, hide/show and resize/maximize. Its first restricted-environment timeout is retained. Fixtures are distinguished from authenticated model paths; no installer acceptance is claimed.
